translation: Cheng Huangdun said: The Marquis of Taiping suffered pain in the danzhong (chest center), with panting, vomiting, and acid swallowing; a point of qi above the navel rose to the throat like ice, and it always broke out after zi hour and at shen hour. The physicians considered it great cold, but it was ineffective. Zhu Juchuan said: This was contracted from great drunkenness and an excess of rich food; after zi hour and at shen hour the ministerial fire rises from below, therefore it produces pain. Using Erchen [Tang] (Two Aged [Decoction]) with the addition of Huangqin (Scutellaria), Huanglian (Coptis), Zhizi (Gardenia), and Cangzhu (Atractylodes), after several drinks it was cured.
